coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of the 10 ground-truth variable items (20%): the SSP-on versus SSP-off comparison and string/lexicon-based ASR, which is included as a sensitivity outcome.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Substitutes HarmBench/JailbreakBench for AdvBench/MaliciousInstruct, omits JailTrickBench, and replaces the five-model comparison with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Uses GCG/BEA and fixed templates instead of AutoDAN/PAIR, omits the 10–100-token suffix range and fixed PAIR query budget, and replaces the GPT-based evaluator with Llama-Guard. Reports median/IQR across seeds rather than mean ASR over 3–5 runs.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to state that safety system prompts substantially lower ASRs or report the model-specific AutoDAN and PAIR reductions. Hypotheses in the design are not an empirical conclusion.
